Poison Resistance is one of the Defenses which mitigates Lightning Damage during Combat Calculations.

## Contents

- 1 Value

- 2 Calculations

- 2.1 Shred

- 2.2 Poison Stacks

- 2.3 Base mitigation

- 2.4 Enemy penetration

## Value[]

Poison Resistance is a percentage value with no upper limit.

By calculations, it is negatively affected by Shred, Poison stacks and natural enemy penetration. It is possible for Poison Resistance to go negative, increasing incoming lightning damage.

{\displaystyle TotalResistance=\min(75\%,\%_{Resistance}-5\%*n_{ShredStacks}-5\%*n_{PoisonStacks})-n_{zoneLevel}\%}

### Shred[]

Poison Shred stacks reduce Poison Resistance by 5% each. It has 60% less effectiveness against players and bosses.

### Poison Stacks[]

A Poison stack itself reduces Poison Resistance by 5% each. It has 60% less effectiveness against players and bosses.

### Base mitigation[]

Up to 75% of resistance is used for base mitigation, any leftover portion is ignored.

### Enemy penetration[]

Enemies naturally penetrate 1% of resistance per area level, up to 75%.
